title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode4 The Perfect Training Schedule

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, Kiritani...
You expect us to do all of these things?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have everything scheduled down to the minute. Not only that, it says to do “at least” a hundred reps for each of these drills and exercises!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, what's written for me looks different from what she's written for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm supposed to run five kilometers and do three sets of a hundred squats and twenty-second planks... And that's before heading to school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right. That's different from what I have here. I'm supposed to run, do push-ups and one-legged balancing exercises.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After school, I'm supposed to run home, then run another eight kilometers. Following that, I have to do single-leg bridges and fingertip push-ups...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And there's more. Strength exercises, straddle splits, more push-ups, back stretches... More one-legged stands, more planking, airplanes, leg cradles...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Finally, how much time we should be spending each day exercising and sleeping, as well as when to go to bed and wake up...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So this is why you asked us for “very detailed” schedules on how we spend each day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I tried to come up with drills and exercises that you both could do whenever you had a minute, since I know that you're both very busy with rehearsals and singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot to give you these weights. Please put them on whenever you exercise, to maximize your gains.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Weights?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also came up with diets for each of you to follow until the day of the event. I wrote down the recipes for everything that you'll be having, along with why I chose them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You went that far?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Since we'll be training together, I wanted to come up with the most effective solutions for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it will be important for us to eat right in order to get in shape... But you have our protein and fat intakes down to the gram.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like what athletes do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is the least we need to do in order to win.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... Yes, you have a point.
Just finishing my stage is going to require a tremendous amount of strength and stamina.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is going to be very hard, but I should be able to manage. I endured everything Mikazukigumi threw at me, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this is really well put together. We should be a lot stronger once we get through it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, but still...
You came up with these all by yourself, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh...
I actually had a little help from a friend...
bgm_area00002
SEKAI Training Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Here.
This is the Shinobi Battle website.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Crossing a log bridge, becoming a water spider, jumping between hanging poles... This looks like a wonderfully fun obstacle course!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thinking of ways to train for this should be quite a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what you mean.
We'll be doing most of these for the first time, so devising strategies for them is really enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we're in this to win, and I wasn't sure I'd be able to handle it all by myself. So, MEIKO, I really appreciate you helping me like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No need to thank me!
I said that I wanted to do this, didn't I♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Still, you really do enjoy coming up with workouts and such, don't you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Working towards a goal, trying to figure out what you're missing, thinking about what you need to do, clearing checkpoints as you go along...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Knowing that you're making progress towards your dream little by little is a wonderful feeling, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And once you've accomplished everything, you start thinking about what to pursue next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew you'd say that, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, let's start brainstorming, shall we?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Starting with the log bridge. Your teammate's core and abs need to be very strong for this, so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I know!
Wouldn't doing L-sit pull-ups be the best option?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that would be...
But I feel like I'd be asking too much of him.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Instead, what if we had him do one-arm handstands? His goal would be to remain perfectly still.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes... No, that's also asking quite a lot of him!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you think so?
Then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to come up with training schedules specifically designed for each of you without her help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, we all have our strengths and weaknesses, so I'd like to make adjustments as needed as we go along.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Now that I know how much effort you and your friend put into these, we have to do our best to succeed!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But I made a commitment.
So, let's give it everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's start training right away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm supposed to start by doing a hundred underhand chin-ups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The log bridge and spider wall obstacles both test your legs and core, but your arms also need to be strong.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: From what I saw, Tenma, you've already made quite a few core and leg exercises a part of your normal workout routine. So, you should be okay there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I'm having you start with a focus on strengthening your arm muscles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
Yes, this really feels like it's been designed just for me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll get started.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Then, turn your palms towards your face and grab hold of the bar.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grab the bar! Lift myself up and... Hold!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good. Now repeat what you just did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Will do!
Hmph! Huff! Hnng!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, good.
You're doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
A hundred is going to be a piece of cake!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, can you try wearing this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? This looks like... A vest? No, wait!
Why's it so heavy...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because there are about ten kilograms of weights inside.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! Ten kilograms?!
That seems like a bit much, don't you think?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even just three or four kilograms would usually increase the difficulty level of this exercise significantly, but I'm making a special exception today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you never know what's going to happen during the event.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
True...
Then, I'll gladly give this a try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hnnnngone! Aaarghtwo!
Huff! Huff...!
Th-This vest has made things so much more difficult...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But I'm not about to give up!
I... I will succeed!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work.
How were those jumping squats?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine... Still, this is harder than I was expecting. My calves are already starting to feel really heavy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, that means this exercise is working like I'd hoped. You're going to need to explode over that vault, after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your calves feeling heavy is a sign that your muscles are growing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, you look like you can handle a bit more. How about we add some extra weight?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Extra weight?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Next, try doing a hundred more while wearing these weighted wristbands.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They will feel a little heavy, but I'm sure you'll do just fine, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
You're joking, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...98, 99, 100.
Phew... Okay, that's one set.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You're amazing, Haruka...>
<Just the fact that you can do one-arm pushups is incredible.>
<I can't even do push-ups using both arms!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's okay to go slow if you're still trying to get the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, if you're just starting today, I recommend doing three sets of ten. After that, you can gradually begin increasing your reps.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if you feel that isn't enough... Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can try placing some weights on your back. I'll try doing that now, so sit back and watch me.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<W-Weights?!>
<How can you still move...?>
<Well, you are aiming to compete in SHINOBI...>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Lemme give that a try.>
<Start by doing ten? I think I can do that.>
<Will I become more like you if I really keep at it, Haruka?>
A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I think we've gotten everything we can out of these simulated runs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we call it a day here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Already?
I can still keep going...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, we should stop. Tomorrow's our big day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. We probably should rest up for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. We don't want any fatigue to linger, so let's do some light stretches and end things here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still...
It's hard to believe how much muscle we've been able to put on in such a short period.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm also surprised.
I feel like we're going to post a really good time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me too.
We have you to thank for being such an incredible instructor, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were able to become this strong because you showed neither us nor yourself any mercy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, my jaw dropped when I first saw your notebooks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But thank you for putting in all that effort, and giving us the best shot possible at winning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shinonome, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're both very welcome.
Now I'm really glad we decided to form a team.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, don't forget that this was all in pursuit of a goal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's make sure we post a good result tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Akito
rows.Line: Let's!
